text:
maya_csm: Kickoff for Borealis pilot. Contacts: Prieto (PM) + Hana (infra). Objective: embeddings + chat for triage. Target: 30 days.

liam_se: Quick infra question — staging egress ok? if not we need an allowlist.

maya_csm: Hana says staging allows outbound; prod might need VPC later. Start with hosted API.

nora_enablement: I'll run two enablement sessions: intro/runbook + evals. Invite product + infra + one support SME.

zoe_successops: Renewal risk: small pilot budget. Set triggers: D12 traffic <50% or eval score <75%. Weekly traction report to their exec.

liam_se: Tech checklist: API keys + allowlist steps, anonymized transcripts, golden answers, small replay (~5k) for p95 testing (target <380ms).

maya_csm: Timeline: D0 kickoff; D0-6 env prep & data; D7-13 integration; D14-20 enablement + evals; D21-30 polish + D30 go/no-go.

nora_enablement: I'll share pre-read & runbook tomorrow.

liam_se: I'll post curl examples and a light test harness tonight.

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Borealis Pilot Kickoff" 2024-09-03 15:00 PDT  invites sent.

maya_csm: Success criteria: integration complete; >=75% on evals; p95 <380ms; customer can run daily evals. Owners: integration=liam_se, enablement=nora_enablement, metrics=zoe_successops, CSM=maya_csm. Action recap: liam = harness (EOD); nora = runbook (tomorrow); zoe = dashboard draft (Wed); maya = finalize agenda (EOD).

liam_se: ack.

nora_enablement: ack.

zoe_successops: ack, wiring alerts now.
file_note: customer referenced in text; participants include only Redwood employees and the onboard-bot per metadata rules
